unit.label: -ent
unit.core_meaning: being, manifesting or possessing a quality
unit.mentor_note: This is one of the most useful suffixes on the exam, because the words that carry it are the adjectives CAT reaches for when it wants a precise temperament: truculent, intransigent, plangent, indigent.

members.meaning: about to happen; posing pending danger

predict_options.text: Possessing or showing a particular quality
Doing something for the first time

discovery.understand_note: Ent turns a quality into a person or thing that has it: truculence gives truculent, diligence gives diligent. When an author picks an -ent adjective, they are naming a disposition, not an action.

applies.prompt: You already know effulgent means radiant. Knowing -ent marks a possessed quality and fulg- means to shine, what does refulgent mean?
